#
#   POST    /microposts                                   → #create
#   DELETE  /microposts/:id                               → #destroy
#

# ╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║ Filter Chain                                                           ║
# ╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
#
#   before   :verify_authenticity_token
#   after    :verify_same_origin_request
#   around   :#<Proc /opt/rbenv/versions/3.3.6/lib/ruby/gems/3.3.0/gems/actiontext-8.0.0/lib/action_text/engine.rb:70>
#   before   :#<Proc /opt/rbenv/versions/3.3.6/lib/ruby/gems/3.3.0/gems/importmap-rails-1.1.0/lib/importmap/engine.rb:37>
#   before   :logged_in_user (only: [:create, :destroy])
#   before   :correct_user (only: [:destroy])
#

class MicropostsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :logged_in_user, only: [:create, :destroy]
  before_action :correct_user,   only: :destroy

  def create
    @micropost = current_user.microposts.build(micropost_params)
    @micropost.image.attach(params[:micropost][:image])
    if @micropost.save
      flash[:success] = "Micropost created!"
      redirect_to root_url
    else
      @feed_items = current_user.feed.paginate(page: params[:page])
      render 'static_pages/home', status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  def destroy
    @micropost.destroy
    flash[:success] = "Micropost deleted"
    if request.referrer.nil?
      redirect_to root_url, status: :see_other
    else
      redirect_to request.referrer, status: :see_other
    end
  end

  private

    def micropost_params
      params.require(:micropost).permit(:content, :image)
    end

    def correct_user
      @micropost = current_user.microposts.find_by(id: params[:id])
      redirect_to(root_url, status: :see_other) if @micropost.nil?
    end
end
